content: Fumadocs vs Starlight: Starlight = Astro-native, fastest static output, built-in Pagefind search + dark mode + i18n, ~3x faster builds; component override system more limited. Fumadocs = Next.js, headless core + Tailwind UI theme, MDX body is a React component so React live previews are native and share the app's React runtime. Starlight React previews are islands (client:load per demo). Nextra v4 also exists but Fumadocs is the polished Next.js pick in 2026.
